needs.what: a player-wide static replacement: if you would proliferate, proliferate twice instead (each proliferate event performed twice, each with its own choice)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: static_effects has replace_draw/replace_life_gain/replace_mill/replace_counters/replace_token_creation multipliers but nothing that replaces the proliferate action; the proliferate op has no hook for a replacement

needs.what: an activated-ability cost that removes N counters of any kinds, distributed as the payer chooses among other permanents matching a selector (other artifacts, creatures and planeswalkers you control)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: the remove_counters cost (engine/costs.py) only removes a single named counter kind from the source object itself; it takes no selector, no exclude_self and no any-kind removal across several permanents
